summary.text: Al Gentry is a Democratic state representative from Kentucky House District 46 who has served since 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Republican Brad Woolridge. Ballotpedia lists him as Alan Gentry.

paragraphs.text: Alan Gentry, also known as Al, lived in Louisville, Kentucky, as of February 2020.
He graduated from Bishop David High School and earned a bachelor of science from the University of Louisville.
He founded the North American One-Armed Golfer Association.

In the 2025-2026 session Gentry was assigned to the House Appropriations and Revenue, House Committee on Committees, Economic Development & Workforce Investment, Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations, and House Rules committees.
